groups.passage:
To: All Staff
From: Facilities Department
Subject: Parking Lot Repairs

Please be aware that the north parking lot will be closed from Monday, May 6, [1] Friday, May 10. During this time, workers will repave the surface and repaint the lines. [2] Employees who normally park in the north lot may use the visitor spaces in the south lot instead. We apologize for any [3] this may cause. [4] questions about the project should be directed to Tom Hale at extension 214.

questions.explain: "From ... through ..." chỉ khoảng thời gian tính cả ngày cuối.

choices: Thank you for attending the safety training.
The work is expected to take the full five days.
Our cafeteria menu has been updated.
The new lot will open next year.
questions.explain: Câu nói về thời gian thi công nối tiếp ý sửa bãi xe; các câu khác lạc đề.
Sau "any" làm tân ngữ của "apologize for" cần danh từ "inconvenience".
"Any + danh từ số nhiều" = bất kỳ; "each/another" cần danh từ số ít, "much" cần danh từ không đếm được.

groups.passage: Brightway Office Supplies is celebrating its tenth anniversary! For one week only, all printer paper and ink cartridges [1] at 20 percent off. Customers who spend more than $100 will also receive a free desk organizer. [2] To take advantage of these offers, simply visit any of our three locations or shop online at brightwayoffice.com. Online orders placed before 3 P.M. are [3] shipped the same day. Don't miss this chance to stock up on [4] at unbeatable prices.

questions.explain: Hàng hoá được giảm giá nên dùng bị động, và chương trình sắp diễn ra nên dùng "will be offered".

choices: Unfortunately, the event has been postponed.
This gift is available while supplies last.
Please return the form to the front desk.
We are currently hiring delivery drivers.
questions.explain: "This gift" chỉ món quà tặng (desk organizer) vừa nhắc; các câu khác không liên quan hoặc mâu thuẫn.
Đứng giữa "are" và phân từ "shipped" cần trạng từ "typically".
Sau giới từ "on" cần danh từ; "essentials" = đồ dùng thiết yếu.

groups.passage:
MEMO
To: Department Heads
Re: Revised Travel Policy

Effective September 1, all business travel must be approved by a division director at least two weeks in advance. This change is intended to help us [1] costs and plan more effectively. Requests submitted after the deadline will be considered only in cases of genuine urgency. [2] In addition, employees are now required to book flights through our designated agency, [3] negotiated discounted fares on our behalf. Receipts for all expenses must be submitted within ten days of [4] return. Thank you for your cooperation.

questions.explain: "Control costs" = kiểm soát chi phí.

choices: The flight to Chicago was delayed by two hours.
Our sales figures rose sharply last quarter.
Such cases must be explained in writing by the employee's supervisor.
questions.explain: "Such cases" nối với "cases of genuine urgency" ở câu trước.
Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định bổ nghĩa cho "agency" dùng "which"; "it has" tạo lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy.
Tính từ sở hữu thay cho "employees" (số nhiều) là "their".

groups.passage:
Notice to Library Patrons

The Westfield Public Library will introduce a new self-checkout system next month. With the new machines, patrons will be able to borrow books [1] waiting in line at the front desk. Staff members will be available to show patrons how to use the system [2] the first two weeks. [3] Patrons who prefer to check out materials with a librarian may continue to do so. We hope this improvement will make your visits more [4].

questions.explain: "Without + V-ing" = mà không phải xếp hàng; hợp nghĩa với máy tự mượn sách.
"During + cụm danh từ" (the first two weeks); "while" cần mệnh đề.

choices: The library will be closed permanently next year.
Simply scan your library card and then the barcode on each item.
questions.explain: Câu hướng dẫn cách dùng máy nối tiếp ý nhân viên hướng dẫn sử dụng hệ thống.
Cấu trúc "make something + tính từ" nên cần tính từ "enjoyable".

groups.passage: Remote work has reshaped how many firms recruit talent. Rather than limiting their searches to candidates within commuting distance, companies can now [1] applicants from across the country. However, managers report that building team cohesion has become more [2]. Without casual conversations in hallways, new hires often take longer to feel connected to colleagues. [3] Some organizations have responded by holding quarterly in-person retreats, [4] others rely on structured virtual mentoring programs.

questions.explain: "Attract applicants" = thu hút ứng viên.
Sau "become more" cần tính từ "challenging" (khó khăn hơn).

choices: As a result, employee turnover in the first year tends to be higher.
Office rents in major cities have reached record levels.
Hallways should be kept clear at all times.
The survey was conducted by a private university.
questions.explain: "As a result" nêu hệ quả của việc nhân viên mới khó gắn kết, dẫn tới câu sau về cách các công ty đối phó.
"Whereas" nối hai mệnh đề đối lập (một số công ty... trong khi số khác...).

groups.passage:
Dear Mr. Alvarez,

Thank you for your recent order from Greenleaf Furniture. Unfortunately, the oak dining table you selected is [1] out of stock. Our supplier has informed us that new stock will arrive by June 15. [2] If you would prefer not to wait, we would be happy to issue a full refund or help you [3] a similar model. Please let us know how you would like to proceed by replying to this e-mail. We [4] your patience and look forward to serving you.

Sincerely,
Dana Kim, Customer Service

questions.explain: Bổ nghĩa cho cụm tính từ "out of stock" cần trạng từ "temporarily".

choices: Your table was delivered yesterday afternoon.
We will ship your table as soon as it arrives.
Our showroom is located on Elm Street.
Thank you for applying for the position.
questions.explain: Câu hứa giao bàn khi hàng về nối tiếp ý hàng mới sẽ về ngày 15/6; "was delivered" mâu thuẫn.
"Help somebody choose something" = giúp chọn; "decide" không có tân ngữ trực tiếp kiểu này.
"Appreciate your patience" = cảm ơn sự kiên nhẫn; "thank" cần người làm tân ngữ.
